S.R.O. 966(I)/2022.- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (3) of section 18 of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969) and in supersession of its Notification No. S.R.O. 840(I)/2021, dated the 30th June, 2021, the Federal Government is pleased to levy regulatory duty on import of goods specified in column (3) of the Table below, falling under the PCT Code of the First Schedule to the said Act specified in column (2) of the said Table, at the rates specified in column (4) thereof, namely: -
2. The regulatory duty shall not be levied on the following, namely: -

(a) import under S.R.O. 678 (I)/2004 dated the 7th August, 2004; (b) import under Chapter 99 of First Schedule of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969); (c) import under Fifth Schedule to the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), excluding serial no 22 of Table to Part I, serial numbers 4, 6, 11, 12, 13, 14, 99,100, 102 and 146 of the Table to Part-III serial number 7 of Table-I of Part V(A), serial numbers 3 and 7 of Table-A, serial numbers 2, 3, 116, 117, 172 to 176, 178 to 185 of Table-B of Part-VII of the said Schedule, subject to fulfilment of conditions laid therein; (d) import under sub chapters 3 and 7 of chapter XII and chapter XV of Customs Rules, 2001; (e) import under Small and Medium Enterprises and Export Oriented Units Rules, 2008; (f) import under Temporary Importation Scheme vide S.R.O. 492(I)/2009, dated the 13th June, 2009; (g) import of special steel round bars and rods of non-alloy steel exceeding diameter 75 mm (PCT code 7214.9990) by the seamless pipes manufacturers registered under the Sales Tax Act, 1990; (h) import of Grain and non-grain oriented electrical steel sheets (PCT codes 7225.1100, 7225.1900, 7226.1100 and 7226.1900) under Sr. Nos. 6, 7 and 8 of S.R.O.565(I)/2006 dated 5th June, 2006; (i) import of Sliver cans and Lollipop Sticks (PCT code 3926.9099); (k) import of Rubber Apron & Cots (PCT code 4016.9990); (l) import of vehicles (CBU) by new entrants, as enumerated vide Sr.1, Table-III of SRO 656(I)/2006, in terms of Auto Development Policy; (m) import under PCT codes 1202.4200 and 1517.9000, by registered manufacturers of food and confectionary industry; and (n) import of input materials used for manufacturing of auto parts by local vendors under Notification S.R.O.655(I)/2006, dated the 5th June, 2006.
3. Rate of Regulatory Duty on import of CKD/SKD kits, of home appliances, mentioned in the Table, and of which kits are not specified separately therein, shall be five per cent.

4. Regulatory duty on import of Pine nut (chilgoza) falling under PCT code 0802.9100,0802.9200, 0802.9900 and marble (crude or roughly trimmed) falling under PCT code 2515.1100 shall be exempted and regulatory duty on import of ground nuts in shell falling under PCT code 1202.4100 shall be reduced from 20% to 10%, if imported from the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan.

5 For the purpose of levy of regulatory duty under this Notification, the value of vehicles (PCT Code 87.03) having bullet proofing and other security features shall be the same as determined under Notification No. S.R.O.No.1121(I)/2007, dated the 17th November, 2007.

6. This Notification shall take effect from the 1st day of July, 2022 and if not rescinded earlier, shall remain in force till the 30th June, 2023. [C. NO. 6(2)/2021-CB] (Suraiya Ahmed Butt) Additional Secretary

S.R.O. 1152 (I)/2025.- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (3) of section 18 of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969) and in supersession of its Notification No. S.R.O. 928(I)/2024, dated the 30th June, 2024, the Federal Government is pleased to levy regulatory duty on import of goods specified in column (3) of the Table below, falling under the PCT Code of the First Schedule to the said Act specified in column (2) of the said Table, at the rates specified in column (4) thereof, namely: -
TABLE. Columns: (1) S. No, (2) PCT Code, (3) Description, (4) Rate of Regulatory Duty (%)
2. The regulatory duty shall not be levied on the following, namely: -
(a) import under Notification No. S.R.O. 678 (I)/2004 dated the 7th August, 2004;
(b) import under Chapter 99 of First Schedule of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969);

(c) import under Fifth Schedule to the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), excluding serial no 22 and 23(v) of Table to Part I, serial numbers 99,100, 102, 116(iv) and (xvi),146 and 154 of the Table to Part-III of the said Schedule, subject to fulfilment of conditions laid therein;
(d) import under Temporary Importation Scheme vide Notification No. S.R.O. 492(I)/2009, dated the 13th June, 2009;

(e) import of special steel round bars and rods of non-alloy steel of diameter 50mm and exceeding 50mm (PCT code 7214.9990) by the seamless pipes manufacturers registered under the Sales Tax Act, 1990;
(f) import of Grain and non-grain oriented electrical steel sheets (PCT codes 7225.1100, 7225.1900, 7226.1100 and 7226.1900) under Sr. Nos. 6, 7 and 8 of S.R.O.565(I)/2006 dated 5th June, 2006;
(g) import of Rubber Apron and Cots (PCT code 4016.9990);
(h) import of vehicles (CBU) by new entrants, as enumerated vide Sr.1, Table-III of Notification No. SRO 656(I)/2006, in terms of Auto Development Policy; and
(i) import of input materials used for manufacturing of auto parts by local vendors under Notification No. S.R.O.655(I)/2006, dated the 5th June, 2006.
3. Rate of regulatory duty on import of CKD/SKD kits, of home appliances, mentioned in the Table, and of which kits are not specified separately therein, shall be five per cent.

4. Regulatory duty on import of Pine nut (chiigoza) falling under PCT code 0802.9100,0802.9200, 0802.9900 and marble (crude or roughly trimmed) falling under PCT code 2515.1100 shall be exempted and regulatory duty on import of ground nuts in shell falling under PCT code 1202.4100 shall be reduced to 10%, if imported from the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan.

5 For the purpose of levy of regulatory duty under this Notification, the value of vehicles (PCT Code 87.03) having bullet proofing and other security features shall be the same as determined under Notification No. S.R.O.No.1121(I)/2007, dated the 17th November, 2007.
6. This Notification shall take effect from the 1st day of July, 2025 and if not rescinded earlier, shall remain in force till the 30th June, 2026.

text: GOVERNMENT OF PAKISTAN MINISTRY OF FINANCE AND REVENUE (REVENUE DIVISION) Islamabad, the 30th June, 2026. NOTIFICATION (CUSTOMS)

S.R.O.1064(I)/2026.- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (3) of section 18 of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969) and in supersession of its Notification No. S.R.O. 1152(I)/2025, dated the 30th June, 2025, the Federal Government is pleased to levy regulatory duty on import of goods specified in column (3) of the Table below, falling under the PCT Code of the First Schedule to the said Act specified in column (2) of the said Table, at the rates specified in column (4) thereof, namely: -
TABLE. Columns: (1) S. No; (2) PCT Code; (3) Description; (4) Rate of Regulatory Duty (%)

2. The regulatory duty shall not be levied on the following, namely: - (a) import under Notification No. S.R.O. 678 (I)/2004 dated the 7th August, 2004; (b) import under Chapter 99 of First Schedule of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969); (c) import under Fifth Schedule to the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), excluding serial no 22 and 23(v) of Table to Part I, serial numbers 99,100, 102, 116(iv) and (xvi), and 146 of the Table to Part-III of the said Schedule, subject to fulfilment of conditions laid therein; (d) import under Temporary Importation Scheme vide Notification No. S.R.O. 492(I)/2009, dated the 13th June, 2009; (e) import of special steel round bars and rods of non-alloy steel of diameter 50mm and exceeding 50mm (PCT code 7214.9990) by the seamless pipes manufacturers registered under the Sales Tax Act, 1990; (f) import of Rubber Apron and Cots (PCT code 4016.9990); (g) import of vehicles (CBU) by new entrants, as enumerated vide Sr.1, Table-III of Notification No. SRO 656(I)/2006, in terms of Auto Development Policy; and (h) import of input materials used for manufacturing of auto parts by local vendors under Notification No. S.R.O.655(I)/2006, dated the 5th June, 2006.
3. Rate of regulatory duty on import of CKD/SKD kits, of home appliances, mentioned in the Table, and of which kits are not specified separately therein, shall be four per cent.

4. Regulatory duty on import of Pine nut (chilgoza) falling under PCT code 0802.9100,0802.9200, 0802.9900 and marble (crude or roughly trimmed) falling under PCT code 2515.1100 shall be exempted and regulatory duty on import of ground nuts in shell falling under PCT code 1202.4100 shall be reduced to ten percent, if imported from the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan.

5. For the purpose of levy of regulatory duty under this Notification, the value of vehicles (PCT Code 87.03) having bullet proofing and other security features shall be the same as determined under Notification No. S.R.O.No.1121(I)/2007, dated the 17th November, 2007.
6. This Notification shall take effect from the 1st day of July, 2026.
[C. NO. 6(2)/2021-CB] (Ashhad Jawwad) Additional Secretary
